plain:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: an original portrait atlas for ORDINARY first-year Japanese high-school wind-ensemble club members.
The attached illustration is only a reference for the navy uniforms, warm ivory background and clean hand-drawn painterly rendering. Do NOT follow the reference's attractive/cute idealization. These are the everyday classmates who surround a separate group of eight cute girls and one handsome boy.
PRIMARY REQUIREMENT: clearly natural, plain, individually recognizable faces rather than pretty anime protagonists. Realistic SMALL-to-medium Japanese eyes, many narrow monolids, understated irises with tiny light reflections, no large doll eyes, no eyelashes as decoration, no rosy blush, no porcelain glamour skin, no sleek symmetrical V faces, no glossy airy idol hair. Varied broader noses, longer noses, thicker or uneven brows, wider mouths, ordinary soft jawlines and mild asymmetry. Neutral attentive expression or a modest slightly awkward closed smile; do not give everyone the same charming smile. Natural black/dark-brown practical hair with unstyled flyaways.
These are friendly fictional 15-year-olds, fresh first-year students with short soft chins and some adolescent cheek fullness. NOT adults, not models, not ugly caricatures, not unkind stereotypes, no extreme distortions or visible skin problems. Every face remains warm, dignified, and individually lovable. Their plainness comes from believable non-idealized anatomy, not bad drawing or poor resolution.
Style: polished fine ink contours and smooth soft paint, full natural color, detailed hair and eyes, a realistic slice-of-life school yearbook illustration. Natural medium/low eye placement and believable smaller eyes are essential. NOT cute anime, NOT chibi, NOT kawaii, NOT pixel art, NOT vector, NOT coarse stippled painting.
Composition: EXACTLY TEN head-and-upper-chest portraits in a perfectly regular FIVE-column by TWO-row grid of equal SQUARE cells. Wide 5:2 canvas, ideally at least 1800x720. Full hair inside each cell with a little top margin, same head size and nearly frontal angle. Flat warm ivory background throughout. Navy blazer and white shirt; girls a small plain navy ribbon, boys a narrow navy necktie. No text, numbers, lines, gutters, props or watermark.
All ten are GIRLS, ordinary natural first-year classmates, clearly feminine school styling, no pixie haircuts.
Reading order:
1 broad rounded-square face, small wide-set monolid eyes, short thick level brows, broad low nose, thin wide straight mouth; blunt chin bob and uneven bangs.
2 long oval face with soft chin, small close-set downturned eyes, low fine brows, longer broad nose, small full lips; simple low ponytail with a side part.
3 short wide heart face with full cheeks, small horizontal eyes, thick nearly touching brows, rounded wide nose, slightly asymmetric broad closed smile; plain shoulder-length black hair.
4 broad oval with a high forehead, narrow slanted eyes, straight uneven eyebrows, flat bridge and round nose, fuller lower lip; practical side braid with no bangs.
5 softly rectangular face, small drooping monolid eyes, short curved brows, longer nose bridge, thin compact mouth; ear-covering straight short bob.
6 rounded plump cheeks, small close-set eyes, medium thick level brows, broad rounded nose, wide thin mouth; low twin ponytails and simple straight fringe.
7 narrow oblong face with rounded chin, small narrow eyes behind plain rectangular glasses, low brows, longer straight nose, small thin mouth; straight medium hair tucked behind ears.
8 short broad square face with soft jaw, medium wide-set level eyes, dense thick brows, low wide nose, broad neutral lips; simple high ponytail and uneven side fringe.
9 broad pear-shaped face, small downturned eyes, short fine eyebrows, blunt wide nose, fuller compact mouth; loose shoulder-length slightly frizzy hair.
10 long soft oval face, very small wide-set monolid eyes, high sparse brows, a long rounded nose, thin wide modest smile; long low ponytail with forehead exposed.
Avoid turning these specifications into ten pretty big-eyed heroines.

1 short softly rectangular face, narrow close-set monolid eyes, thick short straight brows, broad low nose, a small uneven smile; plain jaw-length bob with blunt bangs.
2 broad round face, small horizontal eyes, thin arched eyebrows, short wide rounded nose, thin wide neutral mouth; two practical braids with loose flyaways.
3 long diamond face with soft cheeks, small drooping eyes, uneven fine low brows, longer slim nose, fuller lower lip; straight shoulder-length hair with a side part.
4 broad soft square face, small close-set gently upturned eyes, dense straight brows, wide blunt nose, compact full lips; low ponytail and forehead exposed.
5 plump oval face, small wide-set monolid eyes, short curved thick brows, lower flat nose bridge, wide slightly awkward smile; simple long hair with separated straight fringe.
6 narrow long oval with short chin, fine half-closed eyes behind small oval glasses, angular thin brows, long rounded nose, thin lips; unstyled medium hair tied low.
7 compact triangular face with broad lower cheeks, small downturned eyes, short uneven eyebrows, broad nose, full wide mouth; plain ear-covering short bob.
8 broad oblong face, small level eyes, low medium eyebrows, prominent rounded nose, small straight mouth; long straight dark hair with a simple hairpin.
9 short round face, medium close-set eyes, thicker uneven brows, low short nose, wide thin mouth; shoulder-length blunt hair with short fringe.

Keep each face believable and plain rather than idealizing them into attractive anime heroines.

Reading order:
1 girl: broad soft oval, very small slightly upturned monolid eyes, straight thick brows, short wide nose, wide thin modest smile; plain shoulder-length dark hair and long side bangs.
2 girl: softly square full-cheeked face, small close-set drooping eyes, fine angular brows, longer blunt nose, compact full lips; simple low ponytail with short uneven fringe.
3 girl: long oval with high forehead, small wide-set horizontal eyes, thin low brows, broad rounded nose, straight thin mouth; plain long straight hair without bangs.
4 boy: broad round face, full cheeks, very small wide-set monolid eyes, dense short straight brows, broad flat nose, small uneven closed smile; simple short straight black hair.
5 boy: long narrow oblong face with soft chin, close-set small downturned eyes, sparse low brows, longer wide nose, thin straight lips; practical short side-parted hair and rectangular glasses.
6 boy: short broad square face, small horizontal eyes, short thick uneven eyebrows, low blunt nose, full wide mouth; neat very short cropped hair.
7 boy: softly rectangular face, small close-set monolid eyes, medium straight brows, long rounded nose, narrow neutral mouth; slightly messy simple short dark hair.
8 boy: broad pear-shaped face, narrow widely spaced drooping eyes, thick arched brows, wide low nose, compact full mouth; natural short curls.
9 boy: longer oval face with soft cheeks, small sleepy monolid eyes, fine uneven eyebrows, longer broad nose, a wide thin shy smile; flat short hair with a straight fringe and thin oval glasses.
10 boy: short wide triangular face with rounded chin, small upturned eyes, short dense brows, broad short nose, fuller lower lip; plain short side-swept hair.
NONE of the seven boys is a handsome idol. No sharp elegant V jaws or decorative glossy hair. The separate handsome portrait is already designed and must remain the only one in that category.
neckwearEdit: Edit this EXACT 5-by-2 portrait sheet. Change ONLY the neckwear of the seven BOYS (cells 4,5,6,7,8,9,10 in reading order). Every boy must have a simple narrow navy NECKTIE: small triangular knot under the shirt collar with a straight vertical tie blade. Remove all bows and ribbons from those seven boys. Keep the three GIRLS in cells 1,2,3 wearing their small navy ribbons. Preserve ALL faces, eyes, facial individuality, hair, expressions, age 15, body framing, square cell grid, colors, soft paint quality, ivory background and no text. Do not beautify or idealize any face. This is ONLY a uniform-neckwear correction.
